title: Warsong Labor Camp
wikitext:
[[File:Warsong Labor Camp.jpg|thumb|Warsong Labor Camp]]

The '''Warsong Labor Camp''' is located in southeastern [[Ashenvale]], east of [[Fallen Sky Lake]] and southwest of [[Dor'Danil Barrow Den]]. It is a small area containing loggers, harvesters, and [[orc]]ish guards. It is occasionally attacked by [[Alliance]] adventurers since they can strike the guards without fear of retribution, due to the camp's relative isolation. It is this camp that [[Grom Hellscream]] established after he was sent to [[Ashenvale]], to cut lumber, by Warchief [[Thrall]].
